facts.fact: Adam 让学校把他送到 Silver 那里——国王显然又回到了泳池
facts.anchor: He’d asked the school to bring him to Silver, who was apparently back at the pool.

facts.fact: Adam 起先并不知道 Silver 就是 Perak
facts.anchor: He hadn’t known Silver was Perak, not at first.

facts.fact: Adam 向 Silver 供认：他在 the Between 面对了那个人——对方说出自己打算做什么，随后 Adam 一剑将他捅穿
facts.anchor: I faced him in the Between. I saw what he was going to do. He told me, and then I ran him through.

facts.fact: Adam 说明他所杀之人（the Wolf）的图谋：率 Lost Ones 进入 Alfheimr，挑起凡人与不朽者之间的战争
facts.anchor: Lead the Lost Ones into Alfheimr, start a war between the mortals and immortals.

facts.fact: Silver 说明 the Between 是他父亲造来关押她的；Alfheimr 是他们一同锻造的
facts.anchor: Yes. My father made it to hold her. When they crafted Alfheimr together, they wanted perfection.

facts.fact: 面对「她是谁」的追问，Silver 点破：他的父亲是恐怖存在——难道你以为他母亲会逊于他（即被囚的创造女神正是 Silver 的母亲）
facts.anchor: “You met my father, Adam. You know he was a terror. Did you expect my mother to be anything less?”

facts.fact: Silver 坦言他杀了自己的父亲——为了拯救 Adam 的世界
facts.anchor: I killed my father, Adam. I did what I had to save your world.

facts.fact: 谈到仪式时 Adam 当面点破：Silver 曾从他所能影响的各界面抹除关于 the Empress 的信息
facts.anchor: “You scrubbed information about the Empress from the realms, those you could affect.”
